exposure: maternal hepatic steatosis index (HSI) in the first trimester
cohort: A total of 42,589 pregnant women in China were included in this study.
finding: Elevated maternal HSI in early pregnancy was positively associated with the risk of adverse perinatal outcomes, including caesarean delivery, preterm birth, large-for-gestational age (LGA), and shoulder dystocia.
mod_finding: Elevated maternal HSI was associated with an increased risk of caesarean delivery.
